name: Baja 400 Pre-Run Course (KML)
desc: SCORE official pre-run procedure, released Aug 27. 5 pre-run legs (S1–S5), 332 virtual checkpoints, 71 race-mile markers, 28 speed-zone points, 25 danger markers, 12 wash crossings, 40 landmarks.

name: Baja 400 Course Map (PDF)
desc: Official SCORE course map — overview of the full Ensenada loop. Good for phones and printing for chase crews.

name: Waypoints — HDS units (USR v4)
desc: Chase and landmark waypoints (Colonet, El Alamo, 3 Hermanos, km71, San Isidro…). Use this one on HDS Gen2/Gen3 and newer units.

name: Waypoints — older units (USR v2)
desc: Same waypoint set exported in the older USR v2 format for legacy Lowrance units that won't read v4.

name: Access Roads (USR v2)
desc: Access road and trail network — the routes chase trucks use to reach pits and remote sections.

name: Highways (USR v2)
desc: Baja highway network overlay for navigation between pits and back to town.
